statement:
∀ (f F : ℂ → ℂ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ),
  (∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt F (f (γ t)) (γ t)) →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt γ (deriv γ t) t) →
      ContinuousOn (fun t => f (γ t) * deriv γ t) (Set.uIcc a b) → γ a = γ b → cint f γ a b = 0
